name: external_tcga
head: probe

primary.reliability_note: Full BACH reliability (CONCH OOD + MUSK disagree) not recomputed on TCGA; tier uses conformal set size + top-class only (reliability_flag=false).

limitations: Model: Delta-trained UNI2-h LoRA (uni2h_ft), not the frozen uni2h512_lr production probe.
Slide-level labels only; a tumor-slide crop may show stroma or fat.
No benign or in-situ labels in TCGA-BRCA; specificity is vs frozen normal tissue only.
Normal slides are adjacent to tumor and may not be strictly normal.
Sample size is small; bootstrap intervals are wide.
Reliability combiner not applied; reliability_flag forced false.

run_info.source: NCI GDC, TCGA-BRCA open-access slide images
caveats: Labels are slide-level (sample type), not crop-level annotations.
No benign or in-situ labels exist in TCGA-BRCA.
Normal slides are frozen sections; compare frozen tumor vs frozen normal for a fair test.
Fields of view were sampled at random among tissue-rich regions, not chosen by any model.
